about.PLOT: The book's plot beats in their acts, in story order. Drag a card to move it in the bible's order or into another act; arrows are causes and effects.
about.TIMELINE: The book's timeline events in story order, with a lane for each character taking part. Drag an event along the line to change the bible's order.

emptyOf.RELATIONSHIP: This map is empty. Add a character or faction to start.
emptyOf.PLOT: This board is empty. Add a plot beat to start.
emptyOf.TIMELINE: This timeline is empty. Add a timeline event to start.

page.excluded: {count, plural, one {# element of a kind this map does not draw was left off it.} other {# elements of kinds this map does not draw were left off it.}}
page.participantsTruncated: This timeline has more people taking part than it can show: some character lanes are missing.

boundary.title: The canvas could not be shown
boundary.body: Nothing was lost: the map is saved as rows. Try again, or reload the page.

toolbar.openNone: No element on this map matches.

conflict.title: This map was changed somewhere else
conflict.body: Another tab or person saved this map after you opened it. Reload to see the map as it now stands (your unsaved changes here will be lost), or save yours over it.
conflict.gone: An element or relation on this map was deleted from the bible. Reload to see the map as the bible now stands.

edges.NO_RELATION: These two elements are not related in the bible yet.
edges.DUPLICATE_EDGE: That relation is already drawn on this map.
edges.SELF_LOOP: An element cannot be joined to itself.
edges.UNKNOWN_NODE: Both ends of an edge must be elements on this map.
edges.RELATION_MISMATCH: That edge does not match its relation in the bible.
edges.removeFailed: The relation could not be removed. It is back on the map.

errors.FREEFORM_REFUSED: The notes and drawings on this map could not be saved.
errors.UNKNOWN_ELEMENT: The map names an element the book no longer holds. Reload the map.
errors.UNKNOWN_RELATION: The map names a relation the book no longer holds. Reload the map.
errors.DUPLICATE_NODE: An element appears on the map twice.
errors.DUPLICATE_EDGE: A relation appears on the map twice.
errors.EDGE_ENDPOINT_NOT_ON_MAP: An edge joins an element that is not on the map.
errors.RELATION_MISMATCH: An edge does not match its relation in the bible.
errors.SELF_LOOP: An edge cannot join an element to itself.
errors.generic: The map could not be saved.
errors.KIND_NOT_ON_MAP: This map does not draw that kind of element. Reload the map.

history.confirmBody: The map becomes what it was at that save, as a new save of its own. Nothing in the history is lost.

export.empty: There is nothing on the map to export.

order.ORDER_STALE: The order changed while you were moving that card. The board now shows it as it stands.
order.VERSION_CONFLICT: That element was saved elsewhere since this map was opened. The map now shows it as it stands; move it again.
order.ORDER_RANK_EXHAUSTED: There is no more room at that place in the order. Move a neighbour first, then try again.
order.FIELD_VALUES_REFUSED: That act is not one this kind of entry has.
order.generic: The card could not be moved. The map shows the order as it stands.
order.oneAtATime: Move one card at a time: the order changes one element at a time.

search.label: Search this book
search.help: Finds words in names, labels, summaries, fields and relation notes, in any form (ran finds running). Put a phrase in quotes to find its words in order.
search.emptyQuery: Type a word to search for.
search.failed: The search could not be run. Try again.
search.truncated: Showing the best {shown} of {count} results. Add a word to narrow the search.

partial.ELEMENTS_CAP: Only the first {searched} of {count} entries, by name, were searched.
partial.RELATIONS_CAP: Some relation notes were not searched: the book holds more than one search reads.
partial.TEXT_BUDGET: Only {searched} of {count} entries were searched: the book holds more text than one search reads.

errors.QUERY_TOO_LONG: That search is too long. Use fewer words.
errors.QUERY_TOO_MANY_TERMS: That search has too many words. Use twelve or fewer.
errors.QUERY_TOO_MANY_PHRASES: That search has too many quoted phrases. Use four or fewer.
